description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. One call returns prediction market sentiment (Limitless Exchange) + live equity price for a specified ticker. Collapses the prediction-market → stock-price agent chain into a single x402 payment. $0.059/call. Inputs: ticker (required), query (optional keyword filter for prediction markets).
